RORK — IVX IA CHAT REAL-TIME UX IMPLEMENTATION
EXECUTE CODE NOW — NO NARRATIVE REPORT

MISSION:

Fix the real IVX IA Chat production experience end to end.

DO NOT return another audit, plan, certificate, percentage,
narrative explanation or architecture proposal before implementing.

MAKE THE CODE CHANGES NOW.

==================================================
OWNER REQUIREMENT
==================================================

IVX IA Chat must behave like a modern real-time AI chat.

For normal chat/work/task requests:

DO NOT show large status banners such as:

- Working
- Thinking
- Processing
- Loading
- Analyzing
- Completing task
- Senior Developer working
- Verifying
- Running...
- generic progress banners
- internal system-state banners
- narrative operation cards

Normal AI conversation should feel clean and immediate.

==================================================
1. BANNER RULE
==================================================

Remove all routine banners from normal IVX IA Chat responses.

A prominent banner is allowed ONLY for a genuine exceptional state:

CRASH
FAILED REQUEST
NETWORK FAILURE
PROVIDER FAILURE
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
TIMEOUT
BLOCKED AUTONOMOUS JOB
UNRECOVERABLE ERROR
ACTION REQUIRING OWNER INTERVENTION

Do not display banners simply because the AI is generating.

Normal generation must use only a minimal typing/streaming indicator.

==================================================
2. NORMAL CHAT UX
==================================================

Desired interaction:

USER SENDS MESSAGE
→ message appears immediately
→ minimal IVX typing indicator appears
→ first real model tokens arrive
→ typing indicator disappears
→ assistant text streams progressively into the message bubble
→ final message persists
→ no extra status card remains

The user must NOT wait for the entire response to finish before text appears.

==================================================
3. IMPLEMENT REAL STREAMING
==================================================

Audit the current production chat request path.

Identify:

FRONTEND CHAT SCREEN
MESSAGE STORE
API CLIENT
BACKEND CHAT ENDPOINT
AI GATEWAY CALL
PROVIDER RESPONSE HANDLING
DATABASE MESSAGE PERSISTENCE

The current implementation appears to persist complete
responseText after generation; do not assume that architecture
already provides UI streaming. Inspect the actual source. 

Implement REAL incremental response streaming.

Preferred mechanisms:

SSE
ReadableStream / fetch streaming
or another production-safe streaming mechanism already compatible
with the IVX stack.

DO NOT simulate streaming with:
- setTimeout
- splitting a completed response after the fact
- fake typing animations
- pre-generated text revealed character by character

Streaming must originate from the actual live model response.

==================================================
4. STREAMING CONTRACT
==================================================

Backend should emit structured stream events such as:

response.started
response.delta
response.completed
response.error

Where appropriate also support:

tool.started
tool.completed
job.started
job.progress
job.completed
job.failed

Normal text response:

response.started
→ delta
→ delta
→ delta
→ completed

The frontend must append deltas to ONE assistant message.

Do not create one database/chat message for every token.

==================================================
5. FIRST-TOKEN PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Measure:

SEND TIME
REQUEST RECEIVED TIME
PROVIDER START TIME
FIRST TOKEN TIME
LAST TOKEN TIME
PERSISTENCE COMPLETE TIME

Return real measurements.

TARGET:

User message visible immediately.

Typing indicator visible only until first real response content.

First token should appear as soon as provider streaming permits.

Do not artificially delay rendering.

==================================================
6. TYPING INDICATOR
==================================================

Use one subtle indicator only.

Example behavior:

IVX •••

or existing minimal typing animation.

Rules:

- show after request begins
- remove as soon as first real text delta arrives
- do not cover the conversation
- do not use a large banner
- do not claim work that has not happened

==================================================
7. AUTONOMOUS TASK UX
==================================================

Distinguish NORMAL CHAT from REAL AUTONOMOUS DEVELOPMENT TASKS.

NORMAL QUESTION:

Only:
typing → streamed response

REAL AUTONOMOUS TASK:

The chat may show a compact persistent task status tied to a REAL job ID.

Allowed status:

QUEUED
RUNNING
TESTING
DEPLOYING
VERIFYING
COMPLETED
FAILED
BLOCKED

But only when backed by actual task/job state.

Do NOT turn every prompt containing words like:

work
build
fix
task
complete
developer

into fake progress UI.

A real autonomous job must exist first.

==================================================
8. ERROR UX
==================================================

Only real errors should produce a visible warning/banner.

Examples:

"IVX couldn't reach the AI service. Retry."

"Autonomous task blocked: GitHub API unavailable."

"Connection interrupted. Reconnecting..."

Provide:

Retry
Details where appropriate
Dismiss

Do not expose:
stack traces
tokens
credentials
internal secrets

==================================================
9. REMOVE STALE LOADING STATE
==================================================

Audit all state variables related to:

isLoading
isThinking
isWorking
isProcessing
isGenerating
taskRunning
pending
streaming
typing

Fix cases where state remains true after:

success
failure
navigation
retry
conversation switch
component unmount

No stuck loaders or ghost banners.

==================================================
10. CANCEL / STOP GENERATION
==================================================

Add or verify Stop Generation behavior.

While IVX is streaming:

user can stop generation.

Must:

abort the active request
stop incoming stream
preserve already-generated text
set message status appropriately
clean typing/loading state

Do not corrupt the conversation.

==================================================
11. STREAM RECONNECT / FAILURE
==================================================

Handle:

network interruption
provider disconnect
partial stream
timeout
app background/foreground
navigation away

Never duplicate already received text.

If a stream fails:

preserve partial response where appropriate
show compact real error state
allow retry

==================================================
12. MESSAGE PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Verify:

user message persists immediately or safely optimistic

assistant message persists after completion

partial/failure state is handled consistently

conversation reload displays the correct completed answer

no duplicate assistant messages

correct ordering

stable message IDs

Existing IVX chat requirements already require persistence,
correct ordering and duplicate prevention. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

==================================================
13. CHAT PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Do not regress long conversations.

Verify with a production-like conversation.

Required:

latest message opens immediately
message virtualization remains functional
older-message pagination works
no visible old→new jump
no duplicate realtime messages
streaming response stays smooth

Existing IVX acceptance requirements already call for testing
large conversations, realtime incoming messages and correct
message ordering. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

==================================================
14. MOBILE + WEB
==================================================

Implement the same behavior for:

WEB
ANDROID / EXPO
IOS / EXPO where shared code applies

Do not create three inconsistent chat implementations.

Responsive behavior must remain correct with keyboard open.

==================================================
15. DO NOT CHANGE INTELLIGENCE
==================================================

The Phase 17/18 intelligence behavior is already verified.

DO NOT unnecessarily modify:

system intelligence prompt
business reasoning
senior developer reasoning
honesty policy
memory logic
model/provider selection

This task is CHAT DELIVERY UX + STREAMING + STATE MANAGEMENT.

Do not retune the AI.

==================================================
16. REAL CODE EVIDENCE
==================================================

MAKE THE CHANGES.

Then return:

FILES INSPECTED
FILES CHANGED
REAL DIFF SUMMARY

Do not invent filenames.

Do not return only recommendations.

==================================================
17. TESTS REQUIRED
==================================================

Add/run tests for:

normal chat has no routine banner

typing indicator appears before first token

typing indicator disappears on first token

real deltas render progressively

stream completion persists final response

provider error shows error banner

success does not show error banner

stop generation aborts correctly

partial response handling

no duplicate messages

conversation reload persistence

real autonomous job displays compact job state

normal question does NOT create fake autonomous job UI

==================================================
18. LIVE ACCEPTANCE TEST
==================================================

DEPLOY the fix.

Then test the REAL production IVX IA Chat.

TEST A — SIMPLE QUESTION

Send:

"Explain in simple terms why the sky looks blue."

PASS:

- user message appears immediately
- no large work/loading banner
- subtle typing indicator
- actual response starts appearing before generation completes
- text visibly streams progressively
- final answer persists

TEST B — BUSINESS QUESTION

Send a real business-analysis question.

PASS:
same real-time behavior.

TEST C — TECHNICAL QUESTION

Send a senior developer reasoning question.

PASS:
same real-time behavior.

TEST D — REAL AUTONOMOUS TASK

Start an actual code-development job.

PASS:

- real job ID exists
- compact task status is visible
- status comes from actual backend job state
- AI conversational text can still stream normally
- no fake progress events

TEST E — PROVIDER FAILURE

Safely simulate/test a controlled provider failure.

PASS:

- real error banner appears
- no false response completion
- Retry works

==================================================
19. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After tests pass:

commit
push official GitHub
deploy production

Prove:
